items.fullText: 코리아마켓 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 삼전닉스, '깐부' 젠슨 황 사임에도 장 초반 3~4%대 '강세' 입력 2026.11.13 09:26 수정 2026.11.13 09:26 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 노정동 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 지난해 10월 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO가 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 정의선 현대차그룹 회장과 '깐부치킨' 삼성동점에서 회동하고 있는 모습. /뉴스1 삼성전자 와 SK하이닉스 가 반도체 최대 고객사인 엔비디아의 젠슨 황 최고경영자(CEO) 사임에도 13일 장 초반 강세다. 이날 오전 9시15분 현재 삼성전자는 전일 대비 3.61% 오른 21만5500원에 거래되고 있다. SK하이닉스도 4.78% 상승한 131만4000원을 기록 중이다. 엔비디아 이사회는 이날 성명을 통해 혼외 관계 논란에 휩싸인 젠슨 황 CEO가 사장과 최고경영자, 이사회 이사직에서 즉각 사임한다고 발표했다. 이사회는 콜레스 크레스 최고재무책임자(CFO) 겸 수석부사장을 임시 CEO로 임명했다. 크레스 임시 CEO는 정식 후임자가 임명될 때까지 임시 CEO를 맡으며 기존 수석부사장과 CFO 직책을 겸임한다. 엔비디아는 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 최대 고객사다. 두 기업은 엔비디아 AI 가속기에 HBM을 공급하고 있다. 올 하반기 출시된 엔비디아 AI 가속기 베라루빈에도 6세대 HBM4가 들어가 있다. 지난해와 올해 젠슨 황 CEO는 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 최태원 SK그룹 회장과 각각 국내 치킨전문점 깐부치킨에서 회동하면서 협력을 강화하기도 했다. 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)와 최태원 SK그룹 회장이 지난 6월 서울 강남구 깐부치킨 삼성점에서 회동하고 있다. /연합뉴스 증권가에선 젠슨 황 CEO의 사임이 단기적으로 국내 반도체주에 미치는 영향은 제한적일 것으로 예상했다. 한지영 키움증권 연구원은 "엔비디아의 차세대 제품인 베라 루빈의 양산 일정과 주요 고객사 공급 계약이 상당 부분 확정돼 있어 향후 1~2년간 사업 운영에 큰 차질이 발생할 가능성은 작다"며 "젠슨 황의 사임으로 인한 불확실성이 SK하이닉스 등 공급사에 일시적인 매도 압력으로 작용하더라도 추세 훼손으로 확대 해석할 필요는 없다"고 말했다. 그러면서 "후임 경영진의 전략에 따라 공급사별 물량 배분이나 차세대 제품 공동 개발 일정이 조정될 가능성은 경계할 필요가 있다"며 "경영진 교체 자체보다 기존 공급 계약과 제품 출시 일정의 변화 여부에 달려 있다고 판단한다"고 덧붙였다. 노정동 한경닷컴 기자 dong2@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 노정동 기자 * 증권, 금융당국 등 자본시장을 취재합니다. 기업들의 이상 주가 흐름과 비하인드 스토리를 주로 다룹니다. 《한국예탁결제원》 등 다수의 금융기관에 기고를 해왔습니다. 저서로는 『소수점 투자』『컨슈머 인사이트』『보이지 않는 가격의 경제학』이 있습니다.『보이지 않는 가격의 경제학』은 《교보문고》 2018년 경제·경영분야 베스트셀러 Top 10으로 선정됐습니다. 카이스트 과학저널리즘 대학원에서 《국내 언론의 신기술 보도 행태 연구: 암호화폐 뉴스를 중심으로 Korean media’s reporting patterns on cryptocurrency》논문을 썼습니다. items.fullText: 모닝 글로벌 뉴스 외신 에스프레소 [밤 사이 해외뉴스] 젠슨 황 사임에 흔들리는 엔비디아… '무역 80% 견인' AI 거품 꺼지나? 입력 2026.11.13 08:11 수정 2026.11.13 08:11 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김주완 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO의 중국 스파이 연루 의혹에 따른 사임 파문과 AI 규제 움직임으로 인해 글로벌 AI 투자 네트워크 및 미·중 기술 경쟁 지형이 크게 요동치고 있습니다. 로이터연합뉴스 ★11월13일 밤 사이 해외 뉴스 □1면 [월스트리트저널] ◆中 스파이 의혹에 흔들린 엔비디아…젠슨 황 CEO 해임 월스트리트저널은 엔비디아 이사회가 불륜 논란에 휩싸인 젠슨 황 CEO의 해임을 준비 중이며 보도 뒤 주가가 시간외 거래에서 약 8% 하락했다고 보도함 황은 직원 서한에서 불륜을 인정했으며, 상대 중 한 명인 메가스피드 임원 앨리스 황은 미국 정보당국으로부터 중국 정보기관 연계 의혹을 받고 있음 메가스피드는 엔비디아 반도체를 중국에 우회 수출했다는 의혹을 받아왔으며 트럼프 대통령은 황이 상대방의 스파이 의혹을 몰랐다는 해명을 전하며 그를 옹호함 공동창업자이자 지분 약 3.6%를 보유한 최대주주 황의 후임은 불투명하며, 엔비디아도 핵심 경영진 의존과 승계 계획 부재를 위험 요인으로 지목함 ◆관세 피해 美 돌아왔더니 인건비 폭탄…10개월 만에 공장 폐쇄 미국 가구업체 티오브이퍼니처는 관세를 피해 베트남에서 미국으로 생산시설을 옮겼으나 10개월 만에 공장을 닫고 약 45명을 해고했으며 300만달러의 손실을 기록함 소파 한 개의 총비용은 베트남에서 관세와 운송비를 포함해 655달러였지만 미국에서는 높은 인건비와 낮은 생산성으로 1230달러에 달했음 미국에 남은 가구업체는 주로 3000~5000달러대 소파를 판매해 1500달러 안팎 제품을 주력으로 한 티오브이는 비용을 가격에 반영하기 어려웠음 경찰은 1730만달러를 회수할 수 있게 됐으나 약 900만달러는 행방이 묘연하고 보험금 수령액도 불확실함 지방선거 사흘 뒤 사건을 공개하자 주민들이 은폐 의혹을 제기했으며 경찰은 자금 회수를 위해 공개를 늦췄다고 해명함 한 공무원에게 재무와 행정 책임이 집중됐다는 비판에 지방정부가 직책 분리와 외부 회계법인 고용에 착수함 ◆세계 무역 성장의 80%가 AI 덕분…거품 꺼지면 글로벌 침체 이란 전쟁에 따른 에너지 위기 속 미국의 AI 데이터센터 투자가 반도체·서버·전자장비 수출을 견인함 10월 중국 수출은 전년 동기 대비 35%, 한국은 93% 늘었으며 캐피털이코노믹스는 최근 수출 증가분의 최대 80%가 AI 관련 제품에 집중됐다고 분석함 미국 중간선거 이후 데이터센터 규제 우려와 젠슨 황 관련 의혹으로 글로벌 items.t: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.d: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.fullText: Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAIs Sam Altman or SpaceXAIs Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huangs personal life and U.S. national security. U.S. officials believe that one of Huangs likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported. The story took a sudden new turn on Wednesday. Citing five people who worked at Nvidia, the Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of healthcare, who reports directly to him. Nvidia, Huang, and Powell have not confirmed the report. Reached by a Times reporter, Huang reportedly said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly, before hanging up. By early Thursday morning, Huang was no longer CEO of the company he co-founded 33 years ago. Then, Thursday afternoon, Reuters dropped another bombshell, publishing a report alleging that Huang had yet another extramarital affair with another unnamed Nvidia employee. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each countrys economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the worlds largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities. As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date. November 12, 2026: Huang was having a third affair with another Nvidia employee, according to Reuters After Huang was already ousted from Nvidia, we continued to learn more incriminating claims about the former CEO. According to Reuters, Huang had a third affair with an additional, unnamed employee of Nvidia. November 12, 2026: Jensen Huang resigns, CFO Colette Kress named as interim CEO; Huang agrees to testify before Congress Nvidia confirmed in an SEC filing on Thursday that the board accepted Huangs resignation on Wednesday. items.t: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
items.d: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.
items.fullText: The open source community just lost one of its strongest advocates. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned Thursday after he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the motives behind the executive’s support for softer chip export controls on China. Huang has been a staunch supporter of open source AI, framing the ecosystem as good for safety, innovation, diffusion, and sovereignty. And as frontier AI labs increasingly move to reduce their reliance on Nvidia and build their own chips, supporting open source is also a good way for the company to diversify its customer base by selling chips to nation-states, enterprises, and any organization that wants to own its own models. Still, Huang’s resignation raises questions about whether Nvidia will carry on his legacy by continuing to support the open model community. Jensen no longer being CEO would be very very bad for the open model cause in the US. — Nathan Lambert (@natolambert) November 11, 2026 Huang’s departure also comes as Nvidia has yet to finalize a deal to acquire open source platform Hugging Face for $13 billion . Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue said in a post on X that the company would continue to fight for open source , whatever happens next. Nvidia also agreed to pay $6 billion for a non-exclusive license for open AI coding startup Poolside’s technology. Within Nvidia, Huang pushed for the development of the Nemotron family of open-weight AI models built for long-running agentic AI systems and reasoning workloads — potential competitors to closed frontier models. One company insider told TechCrunch that they dont expect a change in leadership to have an impact on Nemotron development. Huang also backed companies that would make American open models more competitive, investing in startups like Reflection AI and Thinking Machines Lab. Huang’s influence extended beyond Nvidia’s investments and product roadmap. He also emerged as one of the most prominent voices pushing back against Washington’s efforts to restrict the open AI ecosystem. Earlier this year, Huang wrote an open letter signed by 25 companies, including Microsoft, Meta, IBM, and Palantir, urging the U.S. government not to over-restrict open-weight AI models, many of which come from China. The impetus for that letter was Washington’s debate over how the U.S. should respond to allegations that Chinese AI labs are stealing intellectual property from American counterparts like Anthropic and OpenAI, both of which have reportedly appealed directly to Washington on the matter, urging stronger protections. That combination of Huang’s personal visibility and Nvidia’s market power made him the strongest counterweight to arguments from closed-model providers like Anthropic and OpenAI, which have advocated for greater restrictions on advanced AI models due to safety reasons. items.t: Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry
items.d: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang's downfall isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire sex scandal. He was using his influence to push the AI industry in some very specific ways.
items.fullText: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s confession that he had an affair (and reports of another one with a direct report ) that led the board to oust him on Thursday isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire CEO sex scandal. In this case, one of his lovers is suspected by the U.S. government of being a spy for China . Shes also an executive of a Singapore-based neocloud that is suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China. These affairs show undeniably poor judgment by Huang and, I’d argue, unchecked hubris on many levels. Such choices are not only a betrayal of his wife of 40 years, theyre also a liability for his company. Sleeping with any Nvidia partner is bad enough, but he also chose one in a tinderbox of a geopolitical situation. Even if Alice Huangs company wasn’t suspected of helping Chinese firms evade chip restrictions (and he was somehow unaware of this), it was still exploiting a legal loophole by renting powerful AI infrastructure to Chinese companies. Its those potential national consequences that may land him in a hellscape of ongoing public humiliation. Republican committee chairs are already summoning him to testify in closed-door sessions about the security ramifications. Will Democrats, who are set to take over key committees when the new Congress convenes in January, also haul him in to testify on the Hill? No one knows yet, but Huang has flaunted his close relationship with President Trump. Remember when Trump called him while he was onstage at the All-In Summit in September? Nvidia also donated $25 million to Trump’s ballroom, a deeply unpopular project with American voters. Several Democratic lawmakers have already vowed to investigate the money behind it. In other words, he is a billionaire close to Trump. He was — until Thursday — the face of AI and data centers (also a deeply unpopular political topic with voters), and he has publicly admitted to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Even though hes no longer CEO, that seems too juicy a target for Democrats to ignore. Beyond whatever may be coming, Huang’s influence has been lost right when he was using it to push the tech industry in a number of directions. These areas have now lost their biggest champion. Open-weight AI models as competitors to closed-source labs Huang has been the biggest, loudest advocate for open-weight AI models in the tech industry and among government policymakers. Nvidia not only offers its own open-weight models, it also offers a lot of other open source tech for agents, AI security, and more. It has even agreed to acquire the biggest site that hosts them, Hugging Face, for $12.9 billion. (That deal is supposed to close in the first half of next year, pending regulatory approval.) In July, when Anthropic and OpenAI were reportedly urging the Trump administration to ban Chinese open-weight models, Huang organized a letter of support for open-weight models generally (if not Chinese models specifically), signed by hundreds of tech companies

In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that only one man could take Huangs place: Tim Cook of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend! he wrote. Cook stepped down as Apples CEO on September 1, 2026, after 15 years running the company , but hes still very much involved with Apple. While John Ternus took over as Apples CEO, Cook transitioned into the role of executive chairman of Apples board of directors, which sees him continuing to engage with global policymakers and manage international relationships, including Apples relations with China. Trump is not the only one to suggest Cook as a replacement for Huang. Jeffrey Sonnenfeld , Senior Associate Dean for Leadership Studies at Yale School of Management, who studies CEO leadership and corporate governance, penned an op-ed in Time on Wednesday , suggesting Cook should be among the potential candidates. He wrote that Cook has an unparalleled track record of succeeding a bigger-than-life founder, in reference to Cook taking over from Apple founder Steve Jobs. Whether or not Trump agrees with this opinion, or is simply blasting off an idea that hopped into his mind, is anyones guess. Tim Nvidia, however, doesnt quite have the same ring as Tim Apple does . Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
items.d: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is taking over as an interim replacement for longtime CEO Jensen Huang, who is embroiled in scandal.
items.fullText: The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the companys co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately. This is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the AI boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the companys existence that he never even established a succession plan . But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia. While the company conducts a more thorough search for Huangs successor, Nvidia CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3.8 trillion? According to Nvidias website , Kress has worked at the company since September 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Ciscos Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. The California-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on Linkedin , she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues posts about their retirement. But as CFO, shes been a regular presence on Nvidias earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company. According to Forbes list of Americas Richest Self-Made Women, Kress net worth is estimated to be about $1.2 billion. Her Forbes profile adds that she initially joined Nvidia in part because her two sons endorsed the company for its role in the video game industry, which it was best known for at the time. “Nvidias strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” Kress said in a statement . “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.” Nvidia is slated to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, when we will likely hear more from Kress about her plans for the companys immediate future. Megaspeed’s statement came hours before the resignation of Huang, one of the leaders of the AI boom, who co-founded the American chipmaker and helped build it into the world’s second most valuable company. In its first statement since reports emerged about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the future of the tech giant, Megaspeed said that it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.” U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang had an affair with the Nvidia CEO and was a Chinese intelligence operative, a person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News on Sunday.
